title: Main PA + IEM Monitor Feed
brief: Patch the locked three-way main PA processor/amplifier chain while keeping five aux monitor sends on their intended IEM pack inputs.

routes.checklist: Main L Output → Crossover L Input
Main R Output → Crossover R Input
Crossover High L Output → High Amp L Input
Crossover High R Output → High Amp R Input
Crossover Mid L Output → Mid Amp L Input
Crossover Mid R Output → Mid Amp R Input
Crossover Low L Output → Low Amp L Input
Crossover Low R Output → Low Amp R Input
High Amp L Output → Left Line Array High Input
High Amp R Output → Right Line Array High Input
Mid Amp L Output → Left Line Array Mid Input
Mid Amp R Output → Right Line Array Mid Input
Low Amp L Output → Left Line Array Low Input
Low Amp R Output → Right Line Array Low Input
Aux 1 Output → IEM Pack 1 Input A
Aux 2 Output → IEM Pack 1 Input B
Aux 3 Output → IEM Pack 2 Input A
Aux 4 Output → IEM Pack 2 Input B
Aux 5 Output → IEM Pack 3 Input A

stereoGroups.purpose: Main L/R outputs feed the crossover inputs in left/right order.
Crossover high-band L/R outputs feed matching high amplifier inputs.
Crossover mid-band L/R outputs feed matching mid amplifier inputs.
Crossover low-band L/R outputs feed matching low amplifier inputs.
High amplifier L/R outputs feed matching high line-array inputs.
Mid amplifier L/R outputs feed matching mid line-array inputs.
Low amplifier L/R outputs feed matching low line-array inputs.

labels.text: Controlled manifest preserves locked LIV-020 evidence only; renderer behavior remains owned by locked board code.

puzzle.scenario: You are building a three-way main PA processor/amplifier chain while also feeding five aux monitor sends to IEM pack inputs.
puzzle.objective: Patch Main L/R through the crossover, route high/mid/low crossover outputs through matching amplifiers to matching line-array inputs, and keep Aux 1-5 on the intended IEM pack input path.

constraints.text: Main PA outputs must pass through the processor/amplifier path before reaching speakers.
The five aux-to-IEM routes should not be confused with the audience PA chain.

educationalFeedback.defaultWrongRoute: Trace whether the signal belongs to the PA processor/amplifier chain or one of the mono aux-to-IEM monitor feeds.

puzzle.completionExplanation: The completed patch keeps Main L/R feeding the crossover first, routes each high/mid/low crossover band through the matching left/right amplifier and line-array input, and keeps Aux 1-5 on the intended IEM pack inputs.

broadInvalidRouteRules: LIV-020 does not use LIV-023/LIV-026 broad any-node invalid behavior.
Real endpoint invalid behavior is curated through LIV020_BAD_ROUTE_PAIRS.
False hardware jack behavior is mediated by sfLiv020FalseRoutePair.

behaviorFamilies.description: Curated invalid real-endpoint pairs are allowed to draw red/invalid cables without completion credit.
False hardware jack interactions are handled by sfLiv020FalseRoutePair and are not the same as curated bad-route pairs.

evidenceNotes: addRoute() calls sfLiv020RouteDecision() before committing valid or invalid cable state.
Curated bad-route pairs and false hardware hitbox layout arrays are preserved separately.

curatedBadRoutePairs.caution: This is curated invalid route logic between endpoint IDs. It is separate from LIV020_BAD_HITBOX_LAYOUT false hardware jack coordinates.

falseHardwareJackInteractions.caution: These records describe visible/clickable false hardware jack geometry. They are not curated bad-route pairs and must not be mapped to bad-route pair logic by array index.

invalidRouteEvidence.separationCaution: LIV020_BAD_HITBOX_LAYOUT geometry and LIV020_BAD_ROUTE_PAIRS route-pair logic are preserved separately; no index-based mapping is asserted.

preservation.statusRationale: Corrected after source-route audit: current LIV-020 is a locked Main PA + IEM Monitor Feed board with 14 stereo-grouped PA processor/amplifier/speaker routes and five mono Aux-to-IEM input routes. It remains needs-review because the board has locked gear, label, hitbox, false-jack, bad-route, and vertical layout behavior that must be preserved before any source manifest is created.

falseHardwareLayout.caution: These records describe visible/clickable false hardware jack geometry. They are not curated bad-route pairs and must not be mapped to bad-route pair logic by array index.

behaviorFamilies.description: Curated invalid real-endpoint pairs are allowed to draw red/invalid cables without completion credit.
False hardware jack interactions are handled by sfLiv020FalseRoutePair and are not the same as curated bad-route pairs.

broadInvalidRouteRules: LIV-020 does not use LIV-023/LIV-026 broad any-node invalid behavior.
Real endpoint invalid behavior is curated through LIV020_BAD_ROUTE_PAIRS.
False hardware jack behavior is mediated by sfLiv020FalseRoutePair.
scoringOrPenaltyNotes: Invalid routes use the existing native wrong-route path.
Invalid routes remain non-completing and do not mark checklist rows complete.
This snapshot does not change scoring.
evidenceNotes: addRoute() calls sfLiv020RouteDecision() before committing valid or invalid cable state.
Curated bad-route pairs and false hardware hitbox layout arrays are preserved separately.

lockedBehavior.title: Main PA + IEM Monitor Feed
scrollBehaviorNotes: renderLiv020MainPaAndIem adds sf-live-native-scroll-host-liv010 and sets vertical/horizontal overflow.
The board uses a vertical stack with boardHeight derived from IEM pack placement.
labelBehaviorNotes: LIV020_LABEL_LAYOUT_LOCK and LIV020_LABEL_JSON_LOCK preserve label positions.
IEM INPUT A/B labels are overlays only; no extra IEM equipment is created.
hitboxLockNotes: LIV020_HITBOX_LAYOUT_LOCK and data/live-sound/dev-locks/liv020-good-hitbox-lock-v6r406.json preserve real jack geometry.
Good hitboxes are 38 generated jack keys.
falseHitboxBehaviorNotes: 113 false hardware hitbox layout records are installed by installLiv020BadJacks.
False hardware jacks remain hit-testable but visually neutral/hidden before interaction.
False hardware layout data is not route-pair logic.
badRouteBehaviorNotes: 113 curated bad-route pairs are checked separately by sfLiv020IsCuratedBadPair.
False hardware jack interactions use sfLiv020FalseRoutePair.
hintExclusionNotes: False hardware jacks are not valid required route endpoints.
Future manifest conversion must preserve Show Hints exclusion for false hardware jacks.
cableBehaviorNotes: Invalid/bad route attempts draw red invalid cables and remain non-completing.
checklistCompletionExpectations: Only 19 valid routes can complete checklist rows.
Seven PA route families are stereo grouped.
Five Aux-to-IEM monitor sends are individual mono routes.
browserSmokeExpectations: Board loads as Main PA + IEM Monitor Feed.
One main-to-crossover stereo pair completes as expected.
One crossover-to-amp stereo pair completes as expected.
One amp-to-line-array stereo pair completes as expected.
One Aux-to-IEM route completes as an individual mono route.
Curated bad PA route draws red and does not complete.
Curated wrong IEM route draws red and does not complete.
False hardware jack remains neutral before interaction.
Show Hints does not reveal false hardware jacks.
Score/checklist state does not reset unexpectedly after invalid attempts.
lockedBehavior.caution: Do not create a source manifest until route, good-hitbox, false-hardware-hitbox, curated bad-route pair, hint, score, cable, scroll, label, and checklist parity are defined.
